findings.title: ARC runner pods execute a mutable latest-tag image
findings.what: All dispatched scale-set templates reference chd-ci-runner:latest. A rebuilt, overwritten, or compromised tag can therefore change code executed by CI runners without a reviewed values change. The impact is especially strong for the dind pools because those pods run as root with a privileged Docker sidecar and receive workflow credentials.
findings.fix: Publish each approved runner image under an immutable digest and replace every runner/init-container latest reference with the corresponding image@sha256 digest; update the digest deliberately when rebuilding.
findings.acceptance: Render each scale-set chart and assert that every chd-ci-runner image reference contains @sha256:<64 hex characters> and that no rendered runner or init container uses :latest.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read all five cited baseline references. The dind sidecar itself is digest-pinned, but the runner and init images remain latest-tagged; the hub restricted runner does too. No digest field or other immutable reference accompanies those image declarations.

findings.title: Runner image build executes downloaded artifacts without integrity verification
findings.what: Both copies of the recipe download Node and GitHub CLI archives and extract them without verifying published checksums, then use npx to resolve and execute Playwright by version without lockfile integrity. Version strings do not authenticate the fetched bytes, so compromise or unexpected replacement at any upstream delivery point can inject code into the credential-bearing CI runner image.
findings.fix: Store expected SHA-256 values for the Node and GitHub CLI archives and verify them before extraction. Install Playwright from a committed lockfile with integrity metadata (for example npm ci) or verify a pinned package artifact digest before executing it; keep both recipe copies synchronized.
findings.acceptance: A clean image build succeeds only after SHA-256 verification of both archives and lockfile/digest verification of Playwright; substituting one downloaded artifact with different bytes makes the build fail before extraction or execution.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read both in-repo recipe copies at the cited baseline lines. The base actions-runner image is correctly digest-pinned, but no sha256sum/checksum step exists between either curl and extraction, and npx is invoked from the version string alone. The duplicated BuildConfig recipe preserves the same exposure.
